_comment: Voice contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md 'Forge-Tier Smith' (proud/laconic; pride lives in the spec, never in her own skill). The forge tier is reachable ONLY through the elevator_pass_stamped lift, so the base hub IS the post-permit read and no permit-keyed variant is authored -- v0.15 T4.1, CHOICE-LOG.

hub.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
hub.text: Bench is mine until the second bell. Say it quick.

text_variants.text: You put the miscalibrated one down. It had been drifting toward my slab for two shifts. Say what you need.
The Liscor news came up the shaft this morning. Say what you need. I listen better with a hammer in hand.

options.text: Who decides how a thing gets built up here?
[Ask what the seal news cost the tier.]

options._comment: v0.16 P1 start. requires-hidden on saw_the_failed_temper (banked only by forge_reject_bin, which near_pallass never interacts), so pallass_walkthrough's 3-row hub pin and its index navigation are untouched.
options.text: Nine blades in your reject bin, all failed the same way.

spec.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
spec.text: A full working day at heat, then it stands down cold. Push it past that and the slab cracks. A cracked slab is a season of paperwork and a smith who doesn't work that season.

options.text: How often does someone push it?
Then I'll stand clear of it.

standard.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
standard.text: The city sets the spec. I hold it. That's the whole arrangement, and it's better than it sounds. Nothing built on this tier fails quietly.

seal.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
seal.text: Something under their stone wanted feeding, and now it doesn't. That's all of it that reached this tier. I'd have liked the measurements.

options.text: It was older than the city over it.

commission.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
commission.text: You counted them. Good. My apprentice's hand is the steadiest on this tier and the examiner has failed her nine times running. One of us is wrong and it is not her.

options.text: That sounds like your argument, not mine.

commission_brief.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
commission_brief.text: Hall's through the door past the second bench. Run the temper yourself if you have the eye for it, or read the examiner's own notice on my wall and come tell me what it says. Watch the calibration rig either way. It has been drifting.

commission_drift.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
commission_drift.text: It walks its own tolerance and corrects late. On a slab that is a scratch. On a person it is a season. Do not stand where it corrects.

commission_report.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
commission_report.text: Well? Say it in the order it happened.

options._comment: TALK arm. Banks standards_brokered and goes on to the resolution -- brokering is a separate act from reporting it, which is why it does not bank the terminal itself.
options.text: [The standard measures recovery, not hardness. His own notice says so.]
[Tell her what happened to the calibration rig.]

broker.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
broker.text: Recovery. He has been failing her for coming back, and she has been chasing hardness because I taught her to. So he is right and I am right and she paid for both. Say the rest of it out loud, because I am not going to.

options.text: Nobody was wrong. That was the whole problem.

commission_settled.speaker: Forge-Tier Smith
commission_settled.text: Then it is filed and it is finished. The bench is mine again until second bell.

text_variants.text: The rig is honest again and my apprentice gets a fair reading. I will not thank you over a hot hammer. Take it as said.
You ran it once and it came back. She has run it forty-one times and it came back too. Now the file says so. That is the difference and it should not have been yours to make.
I have been arguing with that man for six years and it turns out we agreed the entire time. Do not repeat that. Especially to him.
